name: io.github.Swih/mistral-mcp
description: Mistral document processing via MCP: OCR, typed extraction, audio and optional advanced tools.

environmentVariables.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mistral API key from https://console.mistral.ai/. Model-specific usage and rate limits depend on the organization tier.

environmentVariables.name: MISTRAL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, TGI, LiteLLM, internal gateway). Setting it routes every call there instead of api.mistral.ai and switches the server to the self-hosted profile.

environmentVariables.name: MISTRAL_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool surface to expose: core (default), admin, workflows, metier-docs, self-hosted. Overrides what MISTRAL_BASE_URL would infer.

environmentVariables.name: MISTRAL_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default chat and structured-extraction model when a call omits model. Useful for account-specific availability and self-hosted model ids.
